from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u083/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-8749ce50.py'
program_text='''def transform(grid):
    """Replace each 3 marker with its horizontally mirrored counterpart."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 3:
                out[r][c] = row[width - 1 - c]
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_text)
exec(compile(program_text, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
